source: Default and expanded-state label-in-name inventories confirmed against Drupal core BlockListBuilder and EntityListBuilder source
evidence: EVID-FULL-SUITE-SUMMARY: 12 distinct Block layout links visibly labeled Configure had accessible names such as Edit Site branding and Edit Main navigation in both default and expanded-state inventories.
BlockListBuilder changes the inherited operation title from Edit to Configure, but EntityListBuilder has already assigned an aria-label using Edit plus the entity label.
The visible word Configure is absent from each affected accessible name.
reproduction_steps: Authenticate as an administrator and open /admin/structure/block.
Locate a visible Configure operation link, such as the Site branding row.
Inspect its accessible name or navigate to it with speech-input software.
Confirm that the visible label is Configure while the accessible name is Edit plus the block name.
expected_behavior: The accessible name contains the visible label Configure, preferably at the start, so users can activate the control by its presented text.
actual_behavior: The links visibly say Configure, but their accessible names begin with Edit and do not contain Configure.
